args.prompt:
Design a MOBILE phone concept for HOLOC-57: Holocene /products at 390px narrow phone width, with permanent Products bookmark and shared hierarchical navigation. Same current IMPLEMENTED Ledger language as desktop: #f1f0eb ground, #fbfaf7 paper, #121210 ink, #23231f strong rules, #57574f metadata, selected/focus vermilion #bb2d14. Newsreader editorial heading, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next UI, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono paths/times. Compact, thin ruled lines, square corners, no blue SaaS redesign, gradients, emoji or decorative illustration. Must remain usable at 320px, no page-wide horizontal scroll. Day/Night control persists; Night uses #1c1a17 ground, #26231f surface, #ede7dd text, #ff6a4d focus. Honor safe areas and reduced motion in eventual implementation.

Show phone Products directory with header 33GOD Holocene, clearly labelled Menu button, current page breadcrumb Products; no horizontal primary tabs or bottom icon strip. Main editorial statement 'Three preparing to launch. One live.' Clearly labelled Preparing to launch and Live sections, vertically stacked compact rows. Product names and actual routes: Tower of Lost Things, Open launch dashboard -> https://s3.delo.sh/projects/tolt/2026-11-18/launch-dashboard/index.html; Green In Between -> https://s3.delo.sh/projects/greeninbetween/2026-11-18/launch-dashboard/index.html; Gruvato -> https://s3.delo.sh/projects/gruvato/2026-11-18/launch-dashboard/index.html; Earshot, Open Live management -> /live. External-link indication in label, publication receipt date as quiet provenance; not a health badge. Source status line 'pjangler / committed .launch.yaml' with age and a separate publication source; numbers are sample design copy, not runtime evidence. Show source unavailable design state as a separate labelled inset if room: missing receipt blocks dashboard action, not lifecycle classification; do not create a fake new product.

Make the screen also communicate the mobile navigation drawer OPEN state, e.g. a second phone state on the canvas if supported, otherwise drawer over directory with the underlying rows partly visible. Drawer hierarchy: Products (/products) major and expanded, Preparing to launch (/products?stage=launch), Live (/products?stage=live); Workspace: Agents (/?view=agents), Projects (/?view=projects), Genesis (/genesis); Media: Voice (/voice), Wax (/wax), Transcripts (/transcripts), Artifacts (/artifacts); System: Candybar (/candybar), Settings (/settings), Mini (/mini), Hooks (/hooks), Legacy dashboard (/legacy). Separate chevron disclosure buttons and navigation links, active Products marker, 44px touch rows, long labels wrap. Clearly labelled Close navigation, dimmed backdrop; intended modal focus containment, Escape closes and returns focus to Menu, and selecting a route closes drawer. Keep desktop IA consistent; don't replace Products with Live operations. No duplicate current-page markers, no new credentials or product operations. Design reference only: do not claim interactions, contrast or responsiveness have been tested.
